cards.text: Samson, an Israelite, took a young Philistine woman from Timnah as his wife, at a time when the Philistines were ruling over Israel (Judges 14:1-4, 15). After the wedding feast, Samson went home burning with anger (Judges 14:19). Now it's wheat harvest time, and Samson takes a young goat and goes to visit his wife.

cards.question: Samson says he wants to go to his wife in her room. What does her father do?

answers.text: He will not let Samson enter
He calls his daughter to the door
He sends Samson out to the fields

cards.text: Her father says he was sure Samson thoroughly hated her, so he gave her to one of the men who'd been with him. Samson's standing there holding a goat, and friend, I've been in some awkward moments, but never one with a GOAT in it.

cards.question: Samson's wife is married to someone else now. What does her father offer Samson instead?
After being turned away, Samson speaks about the Philistines. What does he say about doing them harm this time?

answers.text: He will be blameless in doing it
He will ask the LORD first
He will wait until the harvest ends

cards.text: Then Samson goes out and catches three hundred foxes. THREE HUNDRED, friend, and I can't even catch one chocolate chip rolling off my counter.

cards.question: Samson turns the foxes tail-to-tail and fastens a ___ between each pair of tails.
Samson lights the torches tied to the foxes and lets them go. Where does he send them?

answers.text: Into the hill country of Judah

cards.question: True or false: The fire from Samson's foxes stops before it reaches the Philistines' vineyards and olive groves.

cards.text: The Philistines demand to know who did this. They're told it was Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, the man from Timnah, because his wife was given to his companion.
So the Philistines go up and burn her and her father to death. I think this one hurts, friend.

cards.question: True or false: After the Philistines burn his wife and her father, Samson tells them he will not rest until he has taken vengeance on them.

cards.text: And Samson strikes the Philistines ruthlessly, with a great slaughter.

cards.question: After striking down the Philistines, Samson goes down and stays in the ___ at the rock of Etam.

cards.text: Now the Philistines come up, camp in Judah, one of Israel's tribes, and spread out near the town of Lehi. That's a whole army parked in your neighborhood, and I bet the men of Judah have some questions.

cards.question: The men of Judah ask the Philistines why they've attacked. The Philistines say they've come to ___ Samson and pay him back for what he has done.

cards.text: So three thousand men of Judah go to the cave at the rock of Etam. When I got slid to the back of a junk drawer, nobody came looking at ALL, and these guys send THREE THOUSAND for one man.

cards.question: The men of Judah ask Samson, 'Do you not realize that the Philistines rule over us?' What does Samson tell them?

answers.text: He did to them what they did to him
The LORD told him to go after them
He is leaving Judah for good tomorrow

cards.text: Then the men of Judah tell Samson they've come down to arrest him and hand him over to the Philistines.

cards.question: True or false: Samson asks the men of Judah to swear that they will not kill him themselves.
The men of Judah agree not to kill Samson, but they tie him up securely. What do they bind him with?

cards.text: They lead Samson up from the rock to Lehi, and the Philistines come out shouting against him.

cards.question: True or false: When the Spirit of the LORD comes mightily upon Samson, the ropes on his arms hold tight.

cards.text: The ropes on his arms become like burnt flax, and the bonds break loose from his hands.

cards.question: With his hands free and the Philistines shouting against him, what does Samson find and take hold of?

answers.text: The fresh jawbone of a donkey

cards.text: Samson strikes down a thousand men with it, and then he says that with the jawbone of a donkey he has piled them into heaps.

cards.question: When he finishes speaking, Samson throws the jawbone down. What does he do with the place where he struck down the thousand men?

cards.text: Then Samson gets very thirsty, so he cries out to the LORD. He says, 'You have accomplished this great deliverance through Your servant.'

cards.question: Samson has just told the LORD that He accomplished this great deliverance. What does a very thirsty Samson ask Him next?

answers.text: Whether he must now die of thirst
Whether he can go back home now

cards.question: Samson cries out to the LORD in his thirst. God opens up the hollow place in Lehi, and ___ comes out of it.
True or false: When Samson drinks, his strength returns.

cards.text: Samson names that spot En-hakkore, and the writer says it was still there in Lehi when this was written. He's naming places the way I named my cookie cutter kids, friend: give him a minute and EVERYTHING gets a name.

cards.question: How long does Samson judge Israel in the days of the Philistines?

cards.text: Set that timer, friend, because Samson's story is NOT done yet.
